title: CPF Module Schema: __product name__ module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-dedicatedhost'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

auto_replace_on_failure.description: (Optional) Specifies whether the host should be automatically replaced on failure. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

dedicated_host_group_id.description: (Required) The ID of the Dedicated Host Group in which the Dedicated Host should be created. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

license_type.description: (Optional) Specifies the software license type that will be applied to the VMs deployed on the Dedicated Host. Possible values are None, Windows_Server_Hybrid and Windows_Server_Perpetual. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

maintenance_assignment_required.description: (Optional) Specify whether the Maintenance Configuration should be assigned for this Dedicated Host. Defaults to false.

maintenance_configuration_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the Maintenance Configuration to assign to the Dedicated Host.

platform_fault_domain.description: (Required) Specify the fault domain of the Dedicated Host Group in which to create the Dedicated Host. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

sku_name.description: (Required) Specify the SKU name of the Dedicated Host. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

id.description: The Resource ID of the Dedicated Host.

name.description: The Name of the Dedicated Host.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Dedicatedhost' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
